baseline: v104 plus eligible-history baseline, Phase 2 evidence semantics, Phase 4 compression prototype, and bounded incumbent admission

target_reference.accepted_direction: One deterministic athlete-relative neutral expected-compliance stream, immutable within an invocation and independent of both candidate calendars and the prior winning calendar.
target_reference.rejected_direction: Using the prior winning plan as the next invocation's scoring reference; this creates inter-refresh self-feedback even though candidates are equal within one invocation.
focused_invariants: Sparse and dense candidates receive identical target trajectories.
Removing a candidate run does not lower its target obligation.

first_true_no_evidence_failure.cause: When the horizon count first increased, only the exact far-edge extension received full scoring. Its one-day local neighbor did not reach the finalized objective until the following refresh, when it became an exact-count incumbent neighbor.

score_neutral_fix.change: Fully score bounded single-day neighbors of the far-edge incumbent extension for the first four inherited dates.
score_neutral_fix.result: The lower-cost calendar is selected on the earlier refresh and retained with the identical 25.639980217901282 score on the next refresh.

harness_finding.problem: The simulator plans once per day, executes a committed run, and does not emit the immediate post-upload replan used by production.
harness_finding.consequence: Its old churn gate compared a pre-run plan directly with the next day's refresh and conflated compliant-upload churn with no-new-evidence churn.
harness_finding.required_change: Emit a post-upload snapshot after every completed or substituted run and maintain separate compliant-upload and no-new-evidence stability gates.

broader_replay.result: Progressed beyond the former September 23 failure without a new failure before manual interruption.
broader_replay.qualification: Not a completed 42-day pass; the script was still configured for 91 days and was stopped rather than allowed to run unbounded.
